title: CVS/pharmacy Exclusive Double Station Cash Offer
names_seen: CVS/pharmacy Exclusive Double Station Cash Offer

facts.statement: CVS/pharmacy ran a weekend promotion in which Free Realms Station Cash was doubled on Free Realms Station Cash cards purchased at CVS/pharmacy and redeemed within the offer window.
facts.quote: This weekend only get Double Station Cash* on Free Realms Game Cards purchased at CVS/pharmacy!

article_summaries.title: CVS/pharmacy Exclusive Double Station Cash Offer: January 20 – 22, 2012
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing a limited promotion at CVS/pharmacy stores: Free Realms Station Cash cards bought there would be doubled if redeemed during a set window in January 2012. The page gives no author, and its relative posting time ('4 weeks, 2 days ago' at capture) does not pin an exact publication date. The page wrapper is in French but the article body is English.
